a: As of recent years, Nigeria's president is elected; check current official sources for the latest name.
Nigeria gained independence from Britain on 1 October 1960.
Major Nigerian languages include Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, and English (official).
Lagos (Nigeria) is among Africa's largest cities by population.
The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert, covering much of North Africa.
The Nile is one of the world's longest rivers, flowing through northeastern Africa.
Bitcoin is a decentralized digital currency that runs on a blockchain without a central bank.
A blockchain is a shared, append-only ledger secured by cryptography and consensus.
Cloud computing means using remote servers (storage, compute, databases) over the internet.
DevOps is practices that connect software development and IT operations for faster, reliable releases.
CI/CD automates building, testing, and deploying code (Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery).
Kubernetes (k8s) orchestrates containers: scheduling, scaling, and healing apps across machines.
GraphQL is a query language for APIs that lets clients request exactly the fields they need.
WebSockets provide full-duplex real-time communication between browser and server.
OAuth 2.0 is an authorization framework for granting limited access without sharing passwords.
404 Not Found means the resource does not exist.
403 Forbidden means the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.
